top_signals.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
top_signals.summary: The US government sanctioned an individual and two crypto exchanges it said facilitated money laundering for a combined $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: S&P 500 Has Best Week Since April After Jobs Data: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A sharp slowdown in the US jobs market drove stocks higher while bond yields fell on speculation the Federal Reserve won’t be forced to raise interest rates any time soon.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Slashed Yen Short Bets After US-Japan Joint Efforts
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds sharply reduced bearish bets on the yen after coordinated efforts by US and Japanese officials helped stabilize the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Taking Long Term Approach To Investing: Whitney
top_signals.summary:
Meredith Whitney, CEO of Meredith Whitney Advisory Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss Meredith's approach to personal investing and finance.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
